# justz

> justz is a single-binary CLI that sits next to the `just` task runner. It shows a project's commands as a grouped reference with JSON output, and it fails CI when the documentation and the recipes drift apart. It needs `just` 1.37.0 or newer.

Agents: start with "For agents". Every reporting command prints JSON with `--json` (`help` uses `-j`). Exit codes: 0 success, 1 a check failed or an error, 2 usage error, 3 no match (`resolve` only).

## Docs

- [For agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/igorlino/justz/main/docs/for-agents.md): the JSON contract, safety tags, and the workflow before running a project's command
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/igorlino/justz/main/docs/getting-started.md): install, look at a project, check it, scaffold one
- [Command reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/igorlino/justz/main/docs/commands.md): every command and flag
- [Variants](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/igorlino/justz/main/docs/variants.md): `rich`, `native` and `local-rich`, what each gives and how to choose
- [The command registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/igorlino/justz/main/docs/registry.md): the fields of `commands.json`
- [Checks and lint rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/igorlino/justz/main/docs/checks.md): every rule, its severity and how to silence it
- [Installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/igorlino/justz/main/docs/installation.md): Homebrew, install script, Go, and the `just` version matrix
- [Hooks and CI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/igorlino/justz/main/docs/hooks-and-ci.md): pre-commit hook and GitHub Actions job
- [Shims](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/igorlino/justz/main/docs/shims.md): short commands pinned to a project
- [FAQ and troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/igorlino/justz/main/docs/faq.md)

## Skills
